title: 第13章 11倍涨幅的标的
novel_title: 县城：女友出国要我卖房，给脸了
content_zh:
家族群有李家四代人丁，两百多，接近三百号人。

    李西海在家族中的小辈是排不上号的，存在感也不强烈。

    只不过，要不是群里大爷突然发这条消息，也没有这么多人讨论。

    更多还是长辈发的各种奇葩的新闻、短视频这些。

    微信上有许多兄弟发来消息询问的。

    李西海简单的回复了一下，没有多聊。

    兄弟姐妹多了，感情上有远有近，没那么多话说。

    至于家族群的消息，李西海看了一会儿就没看了，也没回的想法。

    家族群早就安静下去，他这要是回复，只怕又是热闹起来。

    “爸，你真是的，说出去干嘛。”

    “现在好了，大家都知道了。”

    “什么投机倒把，那都是什么年代的事情。”

    “国家都鼓励投资……。”

    李大兴在跟李胜利视频，两人吵了起来。

    关于李胜利关不住话，李大兴不是说了一次两次。

    “大哥，二哥，三姐他们说了多少次。”

    “你就是不听。”

    李西海听着吵架，看到李西洛对他吐了吐舌头，就回房间了。

    爷爷不仅跟老爸吵架，跟其他的亲伯亲叔亲姑都吵过不知道多少次。

    每次爷爷都是喊着，一个个长大翅膀硬了，反倒是教育起老子来。

    李西海耳朵都听出茧子来。

    ……

    周二。

    久岸医疗昨天一波光速拉升，笔直天线，捅穿天际。

    引起极大的热度与关注。

    今天竞价阶段，就直接一字板开盘。

    李西海看了一会儿，就把手机给丢了。

    十个点的收益到手，没让他有太大的波澜。

    自从有系统后，他的心境就变得淡然平静的很。

    这才开始而已，往后还有更多更大的收益。

    想到那时候，李西海淡定的吓人。

    下午。

    李西朋叫出去喝茶。

    两人就坐在顺江边上的茶亭。

    “哥，没想到你竟然炒股啊。”

    李西朋说道：“你不知道，他们都在向我打听。”

    “对了，刚哥他们也知道。”

    李西海：“你说的？”

    “不然呢。”

    李西朋理所当然道：“我也不知道他们不知道啊。”

    李西海笑了笑，不太在意。
content_en:
The family group includes four generations of the Li family, with more than 200 people and close to 300 people.

    Li Xihai is not ranked among the younger generation in the family, and his sense of presence is not strong.

    However, if the uncle in the group hadn't suddenly posted this message, there wouldn't have been so many people discussing it.

    What’s more, there are all kinds of weird news and short videos posted by elders.

    Many brothers sent messages on WeChat asking.

    Li Xihai simply replied without talking much.

    There are many brothers and sisters, and they are emotionally distant and distant, so there is not so much to talk about.

    As for the news about the family group, Li Xihai stopped reading it after reading it for a while, and had no intention of replying.

    The family group has been quiet for a long time. If he replies now, it will become lively again.

    "Dad, really, what are you going to do?"

    "It's okay now, everyone knows."

    "What kind of speculation is this? It all happened in that era."

    "The country encourages investment..."

    Li Daxing was videotaping with Li Shengli, and the two quarreled.

    Regarding Li Shengli's inability to keep silent, Li Daxing said it once or twice.

    "Eldest brother, second brother, third sister, how many times have they said it."

    "You just don't listen."

    Li Xihai listened to the quarrel and saw Li Xiluo sticking out his tongue at him, so he went back to the room.

    Grandpa not only quarreled with his father, but also with other uncles and aunts countless times.

    Every time grandpa shouted, each one grew up and his wings became hard, but he taught me.

    Li Xihai could hear cocoons in his ears.

    ……

    Tuesday.

    Jiu'an Medical surged at the speed of light yesterday, straightening its antenna and piercing the sky.

    Aroused great enthusiasm and attention.

    During today's bidding stage, the market will open directly.

    Li Xihai looked at it for a while and then threw the phone away.

    The gain of ten points did not cause him much trouble.

    Since having the system, his mood has become very calm and calm.

    This is just the beginning, and there will be more and greater benefits in the future.

    Thinking of that time, Li Xihai was so calm and frightening.

    afternoon.

    Li Xipeng asked him to go out for tea.

    The two of them were sitting in a tea pavilion by the river.

    "Brother, I didn't expect you to trade in stocks."

    Li Xipeng said: "You don't know, they are all asking me."

    "By the way, Brother Gang and the others also know."

    Li Xihai: "What did you say?"

    "Otherwise."

    Li Xipeng said matter-of-factly: "I don't know that they don't know."

    Li Xihai smiled and didn't care much.
